The bill is a one-year moratorium on permits for "large data centers," meaning data centers with peak demand of 20 megawatts (MW) or more. It also would require a local public hearing before such facilities are constructed and a statewide data center environmental impact report within a year and a half after the bill becomes law.
- **Her executive order:** On July 14, Hochul took a different route. She signed an executive order calling for the pause on large data center developments for up to one year. The moratorium will apply to what are known as hyperscale data center projects that require more than 50 megawatts of electricity. Reporting says this was a regulatory action instead of a move to stifle AI development.
